entities.name: Sidelink DRX Assistance Information Transmission
entities.description: Procedure where an RX UE sends sidelink DRX assistance information to its peer TX UE for sidelink unicast communication when both UEs are DRX-capable and the information is new or changed.

entities.name: Receiving UE
entities.description: UE that receives sidelink communication and is capable of sending sidelink DRX assistance information.

entities.name: Transmitting UE
entities.description: Peer UE that transmits sidelink communication and is capable of receiving sidelink DRX assistance information.

entities.name: Sidelink Unicast Communication
entities.description: Communication direction between two UEs where both are capable of sidelink DRX.

entities.name: UEAssistanceInformationSidelink
entities.description: Information element containing sidelink DRX assistance information sent from RX UE to TX UE.

entities.name: Information Not Sent or Changed
entities.description: Condition where sidelink DRX assistance information has not been sent previously or the previously transmitted information has changed.

relations.description: Procedure is initiated by the RX UE when conditions are met.
Procedure requires sidelink unicast communication with both UEs DRX-capable.
Procedure involves sending the UEAssistanceInformationSidelink IE.
Procedure is guarded by the condition that information has not been sent or has changed.
